objects.name: books

objects.name: documents

objects.name: html_creation_receipts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE html_creation_receipts (creation_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(creation_key) = 32), note_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(note_id > 0), collection TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(collection IN ('note','article')), input_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_hash) = 64), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at > 0))

objects.name: html_preview_resources
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE html_preview_resources (note_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(note_id > 0), resource_path TEXT NOT NULL, node_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(node_id > 0), approved_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(approved_hash) = 64), PRIMARY KEY(note_id, resource_path))

objects.name: label_recommendation_settings

objects.name: local_images

objects.name: local_labels
